No executable code or commands are present in this file.

As per AUR packaging norms, distributing prebuilt binaries with checksums from the upstream's official release is acceptable. While users must trust the upstream vendor (here, the GitHub release), this does not constitute a supply-chain attack within the AUR packaging itself. The file contains no malicious content.
